scope.title: What this policy covers
scope.body: This policy explains how the SmartFinance web app uses cookies and similar browser technology, including local storage. The mobile apps use device storage instead of browser cookies.

necessary.title: Necessary storage
necessary.body: SmartFinance needs some browser storage to work at all. It keeps you signed in and refreshes your session, and it remembers your privacy choices. None of this is used for advertising.

optional.title: Optional storage and measurement
optional.body: Your theme preference makes the app nicer to look at. Vercel Speed Insights helps us understand how the site performs, and only runs once you consent to analytics. SmartFinance doesn't use advertising or cross-site marketing cookies.

rows.name: Supabase authentication session
rows.type: Browser local storage (not an HttpOnly cookie)
rows.purpose: Keeps you signed in securely by storing your access and refresh session.
rows.duration: Until you sign out, your session expires, or your browser data is cleared

rows.name: SmartFinance consent record
rows.purpose: Remembers whether you accepted or rejected optional technology.
rows.duration: Until you reset it, the policy changes, or your browser data is cleared

rows.name: Language preference
rows.purpose: Remembers which language you've chosen, so the app opens in your language next time.
rows.duration: Until you change it or clear your browser data

rows.name: Theme preference
rows.purpose: Remembers how you like the app to look.
rows.duration: Until you change it or clear your browser data

rows.name: Vercel Speed Insights
rows.purpose: Measures how responsive and fast the site feels, in aggregate.
rows.duration: As set by Vercel for the data it collects

control.title: Manage or withdraw consent
control.body: You can reject optional technology and keep using every core SmartFinance feature. Reopen Cookie preferences anytime to change your mind. You can also clear your browser's site data, though that may sign you out and reset your saved preferences.

thirdParties.title: Who we work with
thirdParties.body: Supabase handles authentication and the app's infrastructure. Vercel hosts the site and, once you consent to analytics, runs Speed Insights. Google is involved when you sign in with Google, under its own privacy terms.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We'll update this policy if our technology or legal obligations change. When a change affects your consent in a meaningful way, we'll update the effective date and ask again.

dashboardOverview.title: Your financial month, in one view
dashboardOverview.description: Balances, recent movements, spending, and savings progress all live on the dashboard, so you can see where the household stands before deciding what's next.
body: The dashboard pulls every account, recent transaction, and savings pot into one screen, so you don't have to open five different views to understand where your household stands this month.
It's built to answer one question first: what changed since I last looked? From there, the rest of SmartFinance — transactions, budgets, savings — is one tap away.

recurringPlan.title: Turn repeated expenses into a plan
recurringPlan.description: Rent, subscriptions, salaries, and regular transfers can each get their own schedule. Once the predictable stuff is visible, the monthly budget gets a lot easier to build.
body: Recurring rules let you put rent, subscriptions, salaries, and regular transfers on a schedule once, instead of re-entering them every month.
Once the predictable part of your finances is visible and automated, building the monthly budget is mostly about the parts that actually vary.

savingsNextStep.title: Give every savings goal a next step
savingsNextStep.description: Saving pots connect goals to the accounts that fund them. Progress and forecasts make it easy to see whether your current contribution is enough.
body: Saving pots link a goal — an emergency fund, a holiday, a wedding — to the accounts that actually fund it, so progress isn't just a number you update by hand.
The forecast takes your current recurring contributions and projects forward, so you can see early whether you're on pace or need to adjust before the deadline arrives.

transferVsExpense.title: A transfer isn't another expense
transferVsExpense.description: SmartFinance links both sides of a transfer between your accounts, so the trail stays intact and nothing gets counted as spending twice.
body: Move money from checking to savings and it's easy for that to accidentally show up as an expense — inflating your spending totals for no reason.
SmartFinance links both sides of every transfer, debiting one account and crediting the other, so your spending numbers stay accurate and the trail between accounts stays intact.

householdVisibility.title: Shared visibility with clear boundaries
householdVisibility.description: Household roles and account ownership let everyone work from the same information, while keeping personal and shared responsibilities easy to tell apart.
body: A household isn't one wallet — it's several people with their own accounts, some shared, some not. SmartFinance keeps that distinction visible instead of flattening everything into one pool.
Roles decide who can invite, edit, or just view, so everyone sees the same trustworthy picture without losing track of who owns what.

portableBackup.title: Your household data can travel with you
portableBackup.description: Portable backup and restore give you another way to hold on to your household's information, preferences, and financial records.
body: Export a household and you get its accounts, categories, transactions, recurring rules, saving pots, and monthly budget data as a single backup file.
Import it back in — on any device, at any time — and SmartFinance rebuilds the household from that file, so your financial history isn't locked into one place.
